text:
Zoe R: Kickoff: draft an "IaC starter" for cloud partners — aim is a lightweight repo with Terraform modules + quick marketplace packaging notes. Target: AWS first, GCP follow-up.
Tom B: 👍 Can we scope minimal deliverables? My suggestion: "modules (vpc, cluster, marketplace bundle)", a tiny example app (nginx + healthcheck), GH Actions for bundle publish, and a short partner onboarding checklist.
Priya N: Agree. Add a docs page about credentials/assume-role patterns for partner accounts and a section for KMS/HSM integration. Keep default variables non-sensitive.
Oscar L: From infra side, default refarch should be: private VPC, autoscaling nodegroup (spot-friendly), service LB with path-based routing, and S3 for artifacts. RDS optional.
Zoe R: Acceptance criteria we discussed w/BD: repo deploys in a partner sandbox with no more than 10 manual steps; CI can produce a marketplace bundle (tar.gz) and upload to partner-owned bucket.
Tom B: Proposed timeline: 2 weeks sprint. Week A: module skeleton + CI + docs. Week B: example apps + packaging + partner checklist + perf matrix. Anyone object?
Priya N: Fine. I'll draft partners.yaml template with fields: partner_id, billing_account, support_email, kms_key_arn, tos_link, legal_ok.
Oscar L: I'll take testing on Graviton and NVIDIA variants. Will add a short perf note for memory tuned instances vs GPU.
Zoe R: Repo layout idea (short):
```
infra/
  modules/
    vpc/
    eks/
    marketplace-bundle/
  examples/
    quickstart/
    prod-ish/
  .github/workflows/publish.yml
  docs/partner-onboard.md
  partners.yaml.template
```
Tom B: For README snippet put something like:
```
module "redwood_partner" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-iac.git//infra/modules/marketplace-bundle"
  region = var.region
  env    = "partner-sandbox"
}
```
Priya N: CI checklist: `terraform fmt` -> `terraform validate` -> `tflint` -> `terratest` -> package -> upload. Add optional `plan` output artifact for partners to eyeball infra changes.
Oscar L: Security note: require partners to provide an assume-role ARN instead of embedding creds. Docs should show minimal trust policy.
Zoe R: Legal/licensing: code should be Apache-2.0. We'll include a short non-binding partner checklist (not a contract) for marketplace submission. Bizdev can attach final legal language later.
Tom B: Should we include a tiny Helm chart for the example app? Makes installs easier in EKS.
Priya N: Yes. Helm + values.yaml minimal. Also include an alternative k8s manifest for partners not using Helm.
Zoe R: Test matrix: create a CSV with columns (region, instance_family, tf_version, accelerator, notes). Oscar we'll rely on your results.
Oscar L: I'll start with us-west-2 & europe-west1 variants. Will test m6g/a1/g5 families.
partner-bot: (automated) Action: New doc template created for partner onboarding. Reminder: add partner contact to thread.
Tom B: Owners: Tom = infra lead (modules + CI), Priya = docs + partner template, Oscar = perf/testing, Zoe = PM & external coordination.
Priya N: I'll also add a short troubleshooting section: common TF errors, IAM role issues, and how to rotate KMS keys.
Zoe R: OK team — follow-up review tomorrow 10am PT. Please open PRs early and add TODOs to the GH project. If a partner needs GCP sooner, we'll add a `gcp/` dir after the first draft.
Tom B: ✅ I'll push skeleton tonight.
Oscar L: ✅ starting perf tests.
Priya N: ✅ drafting partners.yaml template.
Zoe R: Thanks all :seedling:
